storyline.governing_thought: Slides written after the v1.5 freeze for human round r3

eval.purpose: human round r3 source (written after the v1.5.0rc1 freeze, never used for development)

slides.headline: Statement
slides.text: Stores that kept their best managers grew three times faster than the rest of the network over the same period

slides.headline: Statement
slides.text: We recommend closing the two smallest plants and moving their volume to Valencia, where capacity, skills and logistics costs are already in place
slides.support: Savings, risks and the transition plan follow.

slides.headline: Statement
slides.text: La reorganización solo funcionará si los equipos regionales mantienen la relación con el cliente y la central asume la planificación, el pricing y las compras

slides.headline: Statement
slides.text: Approve the €14M investment today, or accept that the savings slip into 2028

slides.headline: Statement
slides.text: Customers do not leave because of price; they leave after the second unresolved complaint, and that happens in the first ninety days of the contract

slides.headline: Statement
slides.text: The new model is cheaper, faster and safer, but only if procurement, finance and the plants adopt the same planning calendar and the same data definitions from the first month

slides.headline: Statement
slides.text: El mercado no ha caído: hemos perdido cuota en los dos canales que más crecen, el online y la venta directa a grandes cuentas, mientras defendíamos el canal tradicional
slides.support: Los datos de cuota por canal y región están en el anexo.

slides.headline: Statement
slides.text: Three decisions are needed from the board today: the budget for wave two, the owner of the programme and the date of the first store conversions

slides.headline: Statement
slides.text: Our growth problem is a retention problem

slides.headline: Statement
slides.text: Every month of delay in the system migration costs about €1.2M in duplicate licences, contractors and manual reconciliations, and the risk of a failed year-end close grows each month
